rationale.risk-routing: Routes tasks into autonomy tiers using risk, verifiability, and capability evidence.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Defines owner authority, pre-delivery review gates, sampling, and demotion checkpoints.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Centers generation-validation asymmetry, review bottlenecks, and declining scrutiny.
rationale.automation-bias: Targets polished-output complacency, passive acceptance, and reviewer skill erosion.
rationale.oversight-theater: Requires owners have time, skill, and authority to reject outputs.
rationale.org-governance: Defines accountability, roles, registries, metrics, and PMO-scale operating protocols.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Maintains persistent delegation, ownership, rationale, performance, and review records.
rationale.framework: Reusable protocol architecture integrates delegation, validation, tiers, and Agile workflows.
rationale.design-only: Buildable decision matrices and protocols remain empirically unimplemented and unevaluated.
rationale.general-ai: Framework governs AI-generated knowledge work across software and non-software domains.
rationale.non-developer: Extends protocols to consulting, marketing, legal, research, and creative professionals.
rationale.assistive: Tier 1 covers human-driven work with suggestion-level AI assistance.
rationale.agentic: Higher tiers govern AI-produced artifacts through gates, sampling, and exceptions.
rationale.metrics: Defines quality error rates and over-reliance competence signals for tier transitions.
rationale.risk-quality: Contributes validation checklists and quality-error tracking for generated outputs.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focally addresses complacency, dependency, skill erosion, and competence maintenance.
